questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Explore new cultures

questions.question: Please explain: *
Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer:
That the destination seemed student friendly with a lot of young people, so it would be easy to meet new people and make friends 
And that there were courses that seemed interesting 
And that the destination seemed like a place with a lot of activities

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Bergen is amazing especially if you wanna go hiking - it is not raining as much as people says

questions.question: How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer:
It was quite easy 
Except being a master student made it a lot harder to apply for courses at UiB

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: There were great introduction meetings for all the new students

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
questions.answer:
Upon arrival I am very satisfied
But the process before arriving was very complicated because Im studying a master

questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.answer:

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer:
I found it nicer to live off campus because you are closer to the city center and can walk everywhere you need - yet it is much more expensive 
You just need to be more active in meting people - if you live on campus then you automatically be surrounded by other people

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Very tuff when you are a master student

questions.question: Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer:
There were (almost) no open courses for master students after the faculty of humanities
I therefore needed to contact the responsible person of each institution to ask if a could get a spot on the different courses
It was a very big puzzle and I used a lot of time on it

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer:
I could call them
But I stressed because it was during the summer holidays and people are on vacation

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: It ended up okay and in the end I almost got all the courses I initially wanted

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: You will succeed in the end - but talk to people and ask all the questions you have

UT.no
